en.headline: Labour Department gazettes addenda to scaffolding safety codes
en.dek: Revised guidance on bamboo and metal scaffolding, including stronger toe-board and fire-retardant requirements, takes immediate effect after publication in the Gazette.
body: The Labour Department today published addenda to the Code of Practice for Bamboo Scaffolding Safety and the Code of Practice for Metal Scaffolding Safety in the Gazette. The changes take immediate effect and are intended to strengthen protection for workers on scaffolding.

Major revisions include setting material requirements for scaffolding toe-boards so they have sufficient strength to prevent workers and objects from falling and do not increase fire risk. Protective screens installed on scaffolding, including nets, tarpaulins, plastic sheeting and canvas, must meet the fire-retardant standards in the Buildings Department’s Practice Note for Registered Contractors 85.

The design and installation of catch-fans must also follow the relevant requirements in the Buildings Department’s Guidelines on the Design and Construction of Bamboo Scaffolds. The codes provide practical guidance for contractors to comply with occupational safety and health legislation.

The Labour Department said the codes have special legal status: failure to observe their provisions may be taken into account by a court when determining whether safety and health legislation has been breached. The addenda are available on the department’s website.

zh.headline: 勞工處刊憲棚架安全守則增編即日生效
zh.dek: 《竹棚架工作安全守則》及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》增編今日刊憲即日生效，加強底護板強度及保護幕阻燃要求。
body: 勞工處今日在憲報刊登《竹棚架工作安全守則》及《金屬棚架工作安全守則》增編，即日生效，以加強棚架工作安全。
主要修訂包括訂定棚架底護板物料要求，確保強度足夠防止工人及物件墮下，且物料不得增加火警風險。安裝於棚架的保護幕（包括保護網、防水油布、塑膠布及帆布）須符合屋宇署《註冊承建商作業備考85》的阻燃效能標準。
斜柵的設計及安裝亦須符合屋宇署《竹棚架設計及搭建指引》的相關規定。守則為承建商提供實務指引，以便遵守職安健法例，保障工人安全。
勞工處表示，守則具特殊法律地位，在刑事訴訟中不遵從條文可作為裁定違反職安健法例的因素。增編可於勞工處網頁下載。
